COST: 370

Breakdown: 260 driving minutes (car2 Belkot runs 64, car1 Suryagadhi/Panchakanya run 126, car1 children run 70) plus 110 in deferral penalties (3 adults at 20 each, 1 elderly at Thakre temple at 50).

Notes:
- Thakre temple can only be reached via Benighat temple from Kalika hospital (41 minutes each way), so deferring the grandmother is cheaper than the 82-minute round trip.
- The three adult labourers at Syaphru village are deferred because a dedicated return trip (70 minutes) costs more than their 60-minute total penalty. If the field team would rather bring them out, this plan can be adjusted to add that trip.
- Naukunda school is not used, since it is not a designated evacuation point.
- The Kakani shelter to Likhu farm road is not used because of the fast floodwater.
